name: Busa Product Hub
description: Product & certification hub for export/trade sellers: catalog/SKU master data, pricing, inventory, channel status (Amazon/Shopify/TikTok Shop/eBay), content readiness, compliance notes, lifecycle state, a certificate expiry tracker (CE/FCC/RoHS/UN38.3/UKCA and the toy-safety EN 71/ASTM F963/CPSIA / CPC), and an approval-gated review queue (channel publish approvals, price-change review, quality holds, lifecycle decisions, and unsourced spec claims). The AirApp itself only ever decides on a review item (approve/request_changes/block) directly onto its own record -- it never creates a product, channel, inventory, or certificate row.

agentPrompts.label: Give me the product hub overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder, then give me the overview: active product count, average margin, inventory value, certificates at risk, and what's waiting in the review queue.

label.en: Bring in products from a file, a price list or a product page
label.zh-CN: 导入商品：Excel、价目表或商品页

agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder and follow "Bring products in, any way": an Excel or CSV file goes straight to `scripts/import-products.mjs`; a supplier price list PDF, a catalogue photo, a product page I point to or text I paste is first transcribed into the template spreadsheet and shown to me. Always the `--dry-run` preview first, the import only after I say yes, and where each product's data came from recorded. Never invent a fact the source does not contain, and never crawl a website.

agentPrompts.label: What am I not ready to answer at the trade show?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder, then tell me which products have missing or soon-to-expire certificates, unsourced spec claims, or incomplete content, so I know what to fix before I'm asked about it in person.
